items.difficulty_reason: The lemma records that a composition of proper morphisms is proper and that the same holds for universally closed morphisms. The proof first observes that a composition of closed maps is closed and then checks universal closedness after an arbitrary base change, where the fibre product of the composition splits into two steps each of which is closed by the corresponding property; finally the two remaining parts of properness, separatedness and finite typeness, are quoted as being preserved by composition.
